role: Fitness-tab 'Sensors' sheet: manage the Polar strap (pair, reconnect, disconnect, stop scan, swipe-to-forget), Stryd/FTMS foot pod or bike trainer, and Concept2 PM5, each as a List section driven by its manager's connection state.
types: SensorManagementSheet: struct View — the sheet; Polar section built inline
FootPodRow: private struct View — FootPodManager (via dependencies) read into AccessorySensorRow
PM5Row: private struct View — Concept2Manager (via dependencies) read into AccessorySensorRow
AccessorySensorRow: private struct View — shared status/badge/buttons/discovered list for a BLE accessory (Link, Device, Content, Actions)
DiscoveredSensorButton: private struct View — one tap-to-pair row for a scanned device (Polar, foot pod and PM5)
toplevel: No globals. Accessibility identifiers 'sensors.root' (26) and 'sensors.pairStrap' (198) used by UI tests.
